name: feature.insights-suite.nodes
description: Insights & Drafting Agent Suite node pack — pure compute building blocks the suite's meta-workflows use. variance-compute (Actual-vs-Plan for store sales/margin/labor/shrink, flags off-plan metrics) and talent-score (9-box performance×potential readiness). No host surface, no external egress — deterministic math, replay-safe.
author: OpenWOP App

nodes.label: Variance: Actual vs Plan
nodes.description: Computes Actual-vs-Plan deltas + percentages for a business unit's sales/margin/labor/shrink and flags metrics beyond a threshold. Accepts explicit actuals/plan metric maps OR a tabular rows set carrying metric/actual/plan columns. FAILS CLOSED with insufficient_data when zero metrics could be evaluated, and again when every metric read has a plan of 0 — an empty or uncomparable variance set is never reported as 'on_plan'. A NULL/blank/boolean cell is an absence, never a zero (ADR 0599 §3 + §Correction 1). Pure compute.

nodes.label: Talent: 9-box readiness
nodes.description: Maps a person's performance (1-3) × potential (1-3) to a 9-box cell + a readiness category. Ratings come from explicit inputs (clamped into 1-3) or a rows review set matched on subjectId (NOT clamped — the source scale is unknowable to the node). FAILS CLOSED with insufficient_data when either rating is absent, ambiguous_data when the review rows disagree across cycles, and unknown_scale when a row rating falls outside 1-3 — a named person is never placed in a 9-box cell from missing, arbitrary or mis-scaled data (ADR 0599 §3 + §Correction 1/4). Pure compute.
